summary: Frontend-only targeted retest of Class Cue Calendar Week/Month fix (CalendarV3). Verified week view now renders 7 side-by-side columns Sun 14 - Sat 20 (Saturday/Sunday present), events correctly isolated to Tue 16, week nav (prev/next/today) shifts exactly 7 days, Day view unchanged (single Tue 16 column, 3 sessions, edit buttons), Month view renders 42 cells / 6 rows with date numbers, correct outside-month faded cells (May 31 leading, Jul 1-11 trailing), today (Jun 16) has selected-day highlight, month nav goes MAY 2026 / JULY 2026 / back to JUNE 2026. Add Class (2026-06-18 'Test Class') and Edit Class (ses-2 Science moved to 2026-06-19) both reflected correctly in Week AND Month views and persisted across reload. Zero console errors. One real remaining CSS defect found: the day-label header row is still a 5-column grid, so 7 labels wrap into 2 rows and are misaligned with the 7-column body grid in BOTH week and month views.

ui_bugs.issue: Header day labels still laid out in 5 columns (computed grid-template-columns = 5 x 178.6px) while the body .calendar-grid is 7 x 127.6px. Result: 'Fri 19' and 'Sat 20' (week) / 'Fri' and 'Sat' (month) wrap onto a SECOND row and every label is horizontally misaligned with its column (e.g. 'Test Class' on Thu 18 visually sits under the 'Wed 17' label). ROOT CAUSE: App.css lines 17-18 use DESCENDANT selectors '.calendar-week .week-head' / '.calendar-month .week-head', but in App.js the classes are on the SAME element (<div className={`week-head calendar-${view}`}>), so those rules never match and the base rule '.week-head,.calendar-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}' wins. FIX: change to compound selectors '.week-head.calendar-week', '.week-head.calendar-month', '.week-head.calendar-day'.

Month cell height fixed at 110px with overflow:hidden; when a date has 3 events the 3rd event is visually clipped (observed on Jun 16 before edits - '14:00 Physics' cut off). Consider taller cells / '+N more' indicator.

saveSession does sessions.filter(id!==) then appends, so an edited session moves to the end of its day stack and events are not sorted by startTime (after editing, Tue 16 showed 09:00, 14:00, 11:00). Sort daySessions by startTime before render.

issues: Header labels wrap to a second row and do not align with columns (see ui_bug above)
Month view: 6 rows always rendered even when the month needs only 5, producing an entire trailing row of faded next-month dates (cosmetic; spec asked for 42 cells so acceptable)

action_items: Fix App.css: replace descendant selectors '.calendar-week .week-head' / '.calendar-month .week-head' / '.calendar-day .week-head' with compound selectors '.week-head.calendar-week' / '.week-head.calendar-month' / '.week-head.calendar-day' so the header row uses 7 (or 1) columns and aligns with the body grid.
Increase month cell height or add overflow handling ('+N more') so a 3rd event is not clipped.
Sort each day's sessions by startTime when rendering.
critical_code_review_comments: CSS class collision: week-head and calendar-{view} are siblings on one element; descendant selectors silently fail. This is the single remaining cause of the original 'Sat/Sun missing' visual symptom in the header row.
Month grid is hardcoded to 42 cells; consider computing 35 vs 42 rows dynamically as originally intended.

rca_of_the_issue: App.js renders <div className={`week-head calendar-${view}`}> - both classes on the same element. App.css targets '.calendar-week .week-head' (descendant), which never matches, so the base '.week-head{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}' rule applies, causing the 7 day labels to wrap into 2 rows and misalign with the correctly-7-column body grid.
